name: Kieu Learning English Skill
description: Produces and QA-checks long-form TOEIC Listening and Reading practice episodes for Maya & Emma English, with exam-format content, audio-only listening attempts, captioned replays, and answer explanations.

quickstart.title: Use in Codex or Claude Code
steps: Open this repository in the agent
Ask: Use the kieu-learning-english skill to create the next Maya & Emma TOEIC practice episode

requirements.install: Clone the repository or run kieu-open-resources install-skill
